items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: And this is John Cole the Ring.

ctx.x: See the Old Basin used to be there. A body of water. Yeah. With scooters coming in from all down the country carrying oysters or choco lumber. And that was a place always where you could make you fifty cents or a dollar. Unloading oysters, getting cold, and eating oysters as you can, you know. Yeah. You could come all along and it used to extend all the way from Basin Street all the way to Byas and John. A big body of water there. You could come right out to your house and go three steps and get yourself a mess…
That's what you call Loyola today, isn't it? Eh? That's what you call Loyola? Oh, no, no, no, no.
